topics.topic: Whether advance_run readiness requires an executable unconcluded, non-waiting element in addition to all input ports holding values
questions: Must readiness require only that every input port holds its value, or must it additionally require at least one unconcluded, non-waiting element that can execute?
Must readiness be determined solely by all input ports holding values, or must a node with no currently executable unconcluded element be treated as not ready?

quotes: A mapped node, once selected, takes its elements in list order, executing every element that has no concluded record and does not wait — an operation element that waits is not reached again here — before the next node is selected; an operation element waits when operation_element_conclusion answers ElementWaiting, whether or not it has a NodeExecution (one waiting for the owner's approval has none), and a node none of whose elements without a concluded record can execute is not ready, so the next ready node is selected among the others;
judgement.why: This asks the same readiness question as P3, and the quoted passage and relevant change have not changed since that judgement.

precedent.topic: Definition of mapped-node readiness for advance_run
quotes: A mapped node, once selected, takes its elements in list order, executing every element that has no concluded record and does not wait — an operation element that waits is not reached again here — before the next node is selected; an operation element waits when operation_element_conclusion answers ElementWaiting, whether or not it has a NodeExecution (one waiting for the owner's approval has none), and a node none of whose elements without a concluded record can execute is not ready, so the next ready node is selected among the others;
precedent.why: The text expressly classifies a node with no executable unconcluded elements as not ready, even if its inputs are present.
